summary_1line: Shatrughna confronts the demon Lavana at the gate of Madhupura, trading fierce words and declaring his intent to kill him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shatrughna stands with bow drawn at the gate of Madhupura as the demon Lavana returns carrying captured creatures at noon.
The gigantic Rakshasa Lavana laughs mockingly at the lone warrior Shatrughna standing before the city gate.
Shatrughna, trembling with rage and tears, declares his lineage as Rama’s brother while sparks of fury seem to burst from his body.
